text:
Marie (CSM): FYI: PelicanCo (mid-market, ~120 seats) has a usage dip ~40% month-over-month and renewal in 26 days. I want to run a short 'de-risk corridor' instead of heavy concessions: 10-day enablement + temporary downgrade window + conditional credit. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Jason (AE): I can do an exec touch Tuesday 10am PT. Need a clear win metric and one-liner on cost savings if caching/batching enabled.

Devin (SE): Their Dedicated config has prefix cache off. That explains token bloat. I can flip a canary toggle and run a 48h experiment. Quick checklist: enable prefix_cache on gpool-7, increase max_batch_tokens to 4096, monitor 95p latency and token-per-session.

Devin (SE): ```
- Canary: prefix_cache=true on gpool-7
- Batching: max_batch_tokens=4096
- Monitor: 95th latency, median, token delta
- Rollback script: rb_cache_toggle.sh
```

Rachel (CS Ops): Add a 1-question survey after enablement: "Did the session resolve your blockers? (Y/N)" — structured answers help triage.

Luis (Product): If they can surface 3 failing prompts I'll triage reranker/model variant behavior. Also check region-affinity for latency spikes.

Marie (CSM): Plan (10-day de-risk corridor):
- Day 0: Exec call (Jason) + commit to 48h cache trial (Devin)
- Days 1-6: Two 30-min power-user enablement sessions (Devin/Rachel)
- Day 5: Collect up to 5 failing prompts/log snippets (Marie)
- Day 8: Offer one-month downgrade window with data retention OR 10% overage credit on 6-month renewal (commercial: Jason)

Jason (AE): I'll draft downgrade language and acceptable usage baseline. Marie, can you attach last 3 invoices + 30/60/90 usage?

Marie (CSM): Attaching invoices now. Objective: preserve runway, not give permanent concessions. :rocket:

notify-bot: Meeting created "PelicanCo exec check-in" Tue 10:00 AM PT (invite sent)

Devin (SE): I'll post 48h trial results to this thread with 95/median latency and token spend delta. If token spend drops >20% we have a clear renewal lever.

Rachel (CS Ops): Scheduling enablement and survey prep.

Marie (CSM): Will capture this as a micro-save template if successful. Updates after exec call + trial.
